param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Input protein sequences
param.help: FASTA file containing protein sequences to classify

tool.help:
**ProFam: Protein Family Classification**
ProFam uses deep learning to classify proteins into families and predict functional annotations.
**Input:** - FASTA file with protein sequences
**Output:** - Family classifications with confidence scores - Functional domain annotations - GO term predictions
**Features:** - Fast classification using pre-trained embeddings - Support for novel protein families - Multi-level hierarchy (superfamily, family, subfamily)
**Citation:** ProFam: Deep Learning for Protein Family Classification (2024)
